description: Save artboards as SVG files with the full SVG Options (File > Save As > SVG): profile, font subsetting, encoding, editing data, slices, XMP, variables, text options, SVGZ compression. For lean SVG for the web use export_web_svg

artboards.description: Artboards to export, 1-based like Illustrator: "1", "1-3,5". Default all

embedImages.description: Embed raster images instead of linking. Default true

fewerTspans.description: Output fewer <tspan> elements (lets the viewer kern text)

fontSubsetting.description: Which glyphs of SVG fonts to embed (text not outlined). Default glyphs_used

includeVariables.description: Include Adobe Graphics Server data (variables and data sets)

optimizeForSvgViewer.description: Optimise for the Adobe SVG Viewer

outlineText.description: Convert text to outlines in the SVG. Default false

outputFile.description: Absolute .svg or .svgz path (.svgz is compressed). With several artboards Illustrator adds the artboard name to each file

preserveEditability.description: Keep Illustrator editing data so the SVG reopens fully editable. Default false

styling.description: Where CSS properties go: internal_css (style elements, default), inline_style, presentation_attributes, entities

textOnPath.description: Use <textPath> for text on a path

name: export_svg
title: Export SVG
